display_long_description:
Run, climb, and swing as a Simi using gorilla locomotion — just your hands and arms, push off surfaces to jump, grab on to climb.

Why Players Are Choosing SimionVR

Multiple Game Modes

Tag, Blocks, horror, and more — jump into whatever mode fits how you want to play, whether that's classic chase, competing against other players, or surviving something worse.

Growing Community

Our Discord is packed with active players, always looking for people to swing with, whether you're in it for casual matches or trying to have fun!

Cosmetics That Actually Mean Something

Earn Leaves just by playing, and spend them on cosmetics to make your Simi yours. New drops will be Crazy!

Built By Players, For Players

We're always adding new content, modes, and maps based on what the community actually wants.

Support For Creators

Tools and support to help creators build and share their own content within SimionVR.

Pick a mode and jump on in
